look_here_first: Look for the very fine-textured Dalea: leaves are consistently 3-foliolate with extremely narrow linear leaflets, and terminal flower clusters form small pink-purple globes.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: perennial, several to many stems from base

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small terminal pink to purple flower heads

lookalikes.differences: The extremely narrow linear 3-foliolate leaves give D. tenuis a feathery look. D. multiflora has white round heads; D. nana is shorter, silky-haired, and starts yellow before flowers age purple.
